title: New GTA 6 Screenshots Revealed via Bloomberg Interview
description: RockstarINTEL reports two new official GTA 6 screenshots shared by Bloomberg after Jason Schreier’s interview with Rockstar North staff, showing Lucia in mud and a fresh Pegassi model.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Official Screenshots Reveal Lucia and New Pegassi Model
socialHook: Rockstar shared two new GTA 6 screenshots via Bloomberg.

sections.heading: Official Screenshots Released
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that Bloomberg published two new official GTA 6 screenshots after granting Jason Schreier access to Rockstar North for an interview with senior staff.

sections.heading: What the Screenshots Show
paragraphs: One image captures Lucia and Jason Schreier covered in mud while drinking beer in an off‑road/dirt racing area of Leonida. The other shows a rear view of a car on Ocean Drive at sunset, identified as a new Pegassi model dubbed the GranForma, with a police helicopter flying low.

sections.heading: Additional Context and Unknowns
paragraphs: The screenshots accompany a Bloomberg Businessweek cover story and are paired with illustrations by Viktor Hachmang. While the images confirm certain visual details, Rockstar has not disclosed a release date or further gameplay specifics.
